svg.title: 300 Hz and 700 Hz sampled at 1 kHz

cc:Work.dc:title: 300 Hz and 700 Hz sampled at 1 kHz
cc:Work.dc:description: 300 Hz and 700 Hz cosine waves have identical amplitudes at every integer millisecond. Between 0 and 1 ms they diverge.
